run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate a GIF from a trajectory file
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelized POV-Ray image generation and GIF creation from an ASE trajectory file using multiple processes
run_pov_from_atoms: run POV-Ray rendering of a single atoms frame by separating organic adsorbates from the surface slab
review_pov_from_atoms: review the pov_from_atoms function that renders adsorbate-on-surface frames using ASE and POV-Ray with bond pairs
refactor_parallelize_generation: refactor the parallelize_generation function to customize covalent radii scaling or ffmpeg GIF generation parameters
